svg.title: From the syllabus to study plans
svg.desc: A class and subject's syllabus holds the topics. Each subject of each section gets one study plan, with its lessons in order. The published routine gives each lesson an expected date. When the teacher reports periods, progress goes up; when they do not, the plan shows as behind.
